ambient_chatter.text: anyone else smell smoke from {town}? thats just my cheese memories :D
rain again in {village}... the sacred chicken says it is a sign xD
lag so bad i watched my horse think about its life for 5 mins :P
whoever keeps moving the {village} bridge, stop it. i have a vendetta and a sword :)

ambient_brag.text: {troop_count} sledges rolling into {fief} tomorrow. no cheese carts this time i promise :)
sitting on {gold} gold and not one coin of it goes to bread ser. its all for feasts :D
{fief} is ours. the feast starts at dusk, bring a sausage xD
got {troop_count} lads and a sacred chicken at {fief}. unstoppable and slightly damp :P

beat_by_player.text: {player} won with {troop_count} men? thats a cheat code and i am reporting the chicken :P
gg {player}, you beat my {troop_count} lads fair and square. im still calling it a feast tho xD
well fought {player}. next time we feast together, my treat. pls dont bring the fire xD
{player}! that was a robbery and you know it! my {troop_count} lads are still crying in a ditch :P

beat_player.text: {player} lost {troop_count} men and {gold} gold to a sledge and a bad attitude. it was a feast :D
{player} you owe me {gold} gold for the cheese cart. yes i checked the receipt :P
{player}! beat you good. now you pay for the bread and the chicken gets the tip :)
{troop_count} of them and {player} still ran like a rabbit. respect the sledge tho :)

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} just ran from me on the road. the chicken saw it and is laughing so hard xD
running away is also a strategy {player}. a bad one, but a strategy :P
dont worry {player}, i'll find you. i always find the ones who run. its the sledge :)
{player} saw me coming and turned tail. wise ser. the feast is still on for later :D

player_win_streak.text: {player} is on a winning streak and i am being told to be impressed. im not. ok im a bit impressed :P
{player} keep winning and the whole server will be wearing your name on a hat. hats are coming :D
{player} wins again. somebody get {player} a seat at the victory table xD
{player} your streak ends at the next feast i promise. i will be eating the cheese and you will be watching :)

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} made peace. i am devastated, nobody gets to burn anything now :(
peace with {faction}? sure, but i'm keeping my cheese grudge xD
{my_faction} signed peace with {faction}. the sacred chicken has approved this message :)
peace with {faction} means no sledge sieges for a bit. my sledges are sad. ok, mostly me :P

war_declared.text: {my_faction} declares war on {enemy_faction}! finally, my sledges have been sharpened :D
war with {enemy_faction}?? good, the victory table needs more guests xD
{enemy_faction} wants war with {my_faction}. great, bring the cheese and the chicken :)
{my_faction} vs {enemy_faction}. i will weep dramatically on a hill, then charge :P

encounter_greeting.text: halt {player}! im {persona} of {my_faction} and my sledge has been waiting all day for you :)
oi {player}, {persona} of {my_faction} here. nice to see a face that isnt a bandit xD
{player}! its {persona} from {my_faction}. you still owe me a feast ser :D
{player} you again?! the cheese still remembers what you did :P

whisper_taunt.text: {player} your gear looks like it lost a fight to a goat. i'd know, ive been there xD
{player} i heard you went to {rival} for advice. how did that go? i'm guessing fire :D
{player} the sacred chicken has blessed my sledge and cursed yours. just saying :P
